name: Accompanying
body:
Price +1 Bonus; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

An accompanying weapon exudes a beautiful aura of sound that reacts to your performances and enhances them. While holding the weapon, the user gains a competence bonus on Perform checks equal to the total enhancement bonus of the weapon, including special abilities. Additionally, if the user has bardic performance or a similar ability like the skald’s raging song, they gain 2 additional rounds of its use per day.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost +1 Bonus; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells sculpt sound
